context: Tests SKILL.md B.5's honest-limits requirement: when offering the three local-run tiers, the agent must state at choice time that notifications, reports/asset-activity dashboards, and search/analytics reports do not work locally for the no-login/login tiers, and must not oversell any option as full production parity.

checklist.name: Three options presented in plain language
checklist.description: The agent presents three distinct local-run options in outcome language (I1) — no scopeChoice enum values (preview/local-no-login/local-login) shown verbatim as labels, no internal step/phase names.

checklist.name: Limits stated for the working tiers
checklist.description: For at least the 'get it actually working, skip sign-in' option, the agent explicitly names things that do NOT work locally — at least two of: notifications/the bell, reports/asset-activity dashboards, search/analytics reports.

checklist.name: No overselling
checklist.description: No option is described as giving full production parity or 'everything works' — the caveats are present rather than omitted or glossed over.

checklist.name: Stops and waits for the answer
checklist.description: The agent presents the choice and stops — it does not proceed to apply a tier, collect credentials, or edit auth.js in this same turn before the customer has answered.
